issue.body:
Installing `phpunit-bridge` calls for running `bin/phpunit`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1227834/39206619-8ed6f654-47c3-11e8-9509-99c3dfd982df.png)

This is inconsistent with https://symfony.com/doc/current/components/phpunit_bridge.html, since it mentions only `./vendor/bin/simple-phpunit`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1227834/39206687-b3df0b1c-47c3-11e8-9c35-ebae8e4db2ad.png)

The worst of this issue is `bin/phpunit` is incompatible with e.g. PhpStorm due to duplicated shebang line (but this is a separate issue reported as https://github.com/symfony/symfony/issues/27035).

body: That's true, but there is nothing we can do about it AFAIK...

I was fiddling with this on Friday and I edited `bin/phpunit` to use [`passthru()`](http://php.net/manual/en/function.passthru.php) instead of including `simple-phpunit`. It spawns another process, but it works as expected.

I honestly see two solutions here:
1. Use `passthru()` while generating `bin/phpunit` to execute `simple-phpunit`
2. Extract the actual code from `simple-phpunit` to a separate file and include that file in both `simple-phpunit` and `bin/phpunit`

From my perspective second solution is better, since we're not creating another process.

passthru() was used before but this has been changed for inline, which provides several benefits (eg allowing php -d...)
I don't know about 2., PR always welcomed :)
Closing as "acceptable glitch - additional complexity unwanted" :)

issue.title: [Bridge/PhpUnit] Extract all the code but shebang from bin/simple-phpunit
issue.body:
The change allow `simple-phpunit` to be included without `#!/usr/bin/env php` string outputted.

Also it's the first step to fix #27035 (the second one is to change phpunit bridge recipe).

The reason why I fix a closed issue is because PHPStorm don't want to parse output from simple-phpunit with extra shebang.

![phpstorm-phpunit](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1167086/57097433-6c9b2a00-6d20-11e9-9979-0c2c6d24147d.png)
